quads.label: AI-native builder, for real
quads.headline: Ships on Claude / MCP / agents — not demos

proof.claim: End-to-end LLM-native systems. ARCS: 60% decision-noise reduction, 3–5× time-to-insight, agentic orchestration in production. A GTM operator who also writes the software is the rare pairing.
Sole-tech-partner capable; aligns eng · design · clinical · ops · commercial. Squat NY: discovery → QA → handoff for a $350M-ARR client, on schedule.
Personalization, lifecycle, growth intelligence. Grayscale: +20% net-new revenue via data personalization across a 10-product regulated portfolio. "Breadth is the product."

quads.label: Regulated / high-stakes fluency
quads.headline: Ships where getting it wrong is expensive

proof.company: Grayscale (SEC/FINRA, $7B AUM) · digital health (HIPAA, $350M ARR) · Axon (gov)
proof.claim: SEC/FINRA ($7B AUM), HIPAA (digital health, $350M ARR), gov (Axon). Twenty years turning the constraint into the product — the genome the record proves.

screen_in: Build-and-embed role — real building, real ownership; not maintenance or pure management
AI-native surface — LLMs/agents core to the product or the work, not a bolt-on
Senior IC / lead / staff / founding scope with decision latitude (can decide without six approvals)
Sustainable, experience-valuing culture — positive-screen signals (GPTW/Comparably, family-friendly, tenure mix in senior roles)
screen_out: "AI" as costume — nothing real for it to do
Junior/entry leveling or "young & scrappy only" framing (risk-register)
996 / always-on grind; wide/loose comp banding across locations for one role (risk-register)
Keep-the-lights-on maintenance with no decision authority
Domain he has no interest in or can't add real value to

dims.label: Rare combination
dims.anchor0: a common single-lane profile many applicants share
dims.anchor3: rewards the moat — operator-who-builds × transversal synthesizer × 0→1-under-ambiguity — a shape few qualified applicants have

dims.label: Domain breadth
dims.anchor0: no relevant domain depth — pure horizontal role, no regulated exposure (a single but genuinely deep or regulated domain scores 1–2, not 0)
dims.anchor3: regulated fluency across multiple high-stakes domains — SEC/FINRA · HIPAA · gov

dims.label: Comp / level fit
dims.anchor0: disclosed comp below senior/staff level — if comp is NOT stated in the JD, score 2 (neutral), never 0
